🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmation: weak overall sector breadth (4/11) and narrow leadership (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 of Top 5 from Technology). Major divergence across large caps (multiple trend-exhaustion names) further supports caution.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +9.43% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: VLO (1W: +7.45% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare weak: NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -13.24% | 1M: -20.36%) BELOW TREND. Communication lagging: CHTR (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG (1W: -11.38% | 1M: -18.53%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.38% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +9.43% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -13.24% | 1M: -20.36%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -11.38% | 1M: -18.53%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -5.67%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated across Healthcare and Select Consumer Discretionary.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.38% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND. Note Major Divergence (≥3 large caps with 1W ≠ 1M — e.g., AAPL, V, MA trend exhaustion) — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but concentrated strength: NVDA (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.01% | 1M: +2.30%) TREND EXHAUSTION, MSFT (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND. Technology is one of four 1W-positive sectors but leadership is narrow and uneven.

8. Financials Outlook?
Flat-to-weak internals: JPM (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.42% | 1M: +1.87%) TREND EXHAUSTION, MA (1W: -2.34% | 1M: +0.77%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Financials are marginally positive on the week but lack broad confirmation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Clear weakness: AMGN (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -5.67%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -8.61%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare is lagging within the market’s 4/11 positive picture.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to confirmed ABOVE TREND names (META, AMD, VLO) and utilities/energy where momentum is clear; reduce exposure to lagging Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak breadth; treat new positions tactically until breadth improves.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +7.45% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -13.24% | 1M: -20.36%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities and Energy (both 1W positive and among the 4/11 sectors up). BEARISH: Healthcare and Communication (both materially negative on the week and dragging breadth lower). Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive remains the key risk signal.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch continuation signals and weekly follow-through: META hold of this week’s gains to confirm continuation; INTC weekly strength must find follow-through given negative headlines; ADBE/AMGN need to show stabilization before considering exposure. Failure of multiple above-trend names to extend would deepen CAUTION into defensive posture.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ADBE (+68): Roundtable analyst upgrades; ADBE (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND — sentiment bullish but price is diverging. AMGN (+60): Imdelltra sales surge; AMGN (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -5.67%) BELOW TREND — positive news not yet reflected in price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CHTR (-45): Broadband repricing concerns; CHTR (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price weakness. INTC (-40): skeptical headlines on Mac ecosystem; INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverges from strong price action, watch for distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Technology concentration and weak breadth. META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence between headlines and price (e.g., INTC negative sentiment but strong gains) and several large caps in trend-exhaustion — monitor breadth for confirmation.
